steps.say: In the editor, press Space and wait.
steps.hint: Space is the leader key. Pause after it and a menu of everything it can do appears.
steps.why: You don't memorize Neovim — you press Space and read.

steps.hint: Space twice. Type a few letters of a file name, Enter opens it, Escape closes.
steps.why: Fuzzy finding replaces the file tree for most navigation.

steps.say: Search the whole project for text.
steps.hint: Space, s, g — then type TODO. Escape closes the picker.
steps.why: Project-wide grep is how you find where something is *used*, not just where it lives.

steps.hint: Space, then e. The tree opens on the left; Space e again hides it.
steps.why: The sidebar is for browsing structure; the finder is for jumping.

steps.say: Make the sidebar wider or narrower.
steps.hint: With the sidebar focused (Ctrl + h moves into it), Ctrl + Left / Right changes its width.
steps.why: Window resize keys work on any split, not just the sidebar.

steps.hint: Space, g, g. The practice project is a real git repo. Press q to leave Lazygit.
steps.why: Commit, stage, and diff without leaving the editor.
